body:
ServerAnalytics – Advanced Player & Server Data Tracking for Minecraft

ServerAnalytics is a powerful, lightweight, and fully free analytics plugin for Minecraft servers, designed to help server owners understand player behavior, track progression, and optimize their gameplay experience like never before.

Built for Minecraft server administrators who want deeper insights, ServerAnalytics provides detailed tracking of player activity, including average playtime, session frequency, commands used, and overall engagement patterns. Whether you're running a survival, SkyBlock, RPG, or custom server, this plugin gives you the data you need to make smarter decisions and grow your community.

With ServerAnalytics, you can monitor key metrics such as the average playtime per player, the number of sessions per day, and the first commands executed by players, helping you better understand how new players interact with your server. This is especially useful for improving onboarding, balancing gameplay, and identifying what keeps players engaged.

The plugin is designed with performance in mind, ensuring accurate data tracking without impacting your server’s stability. Its lightweight architecture allows it to run seamlessly in the background while collecting valuable insights in real time.

One of the biggest advantages of ServerAnalytics is that it is completely free, making advanced analytics accessible to all server creators—whether you're running a small private server or a large public network. No paid tiers, no hidden features—just powerful analytics tools available to everyone.

Key Features:
Track average player playtime and session duration
Monitor daily player activity and engagement trends
Analyze player progression and behavior patterns
See which commands players use first
Identify player retention and activity frequency
Lightweight and optimized for zero performance impact
Easy to install and configure
Why use ServerAnalytics?

Understanding your players is essential to building a successful Minecraft server. ServerAnalytics gives you the tools to analyze player behavior, improve retention, and create a better overall experience for your community—all without any cost.

Future Updates

This plugin has huge potential and is actively being improved. Many new features and analytics tools are planned for future updates, including deeper insights, more advanced tracking options, and improved data visualization.

ServerAnalytics is the perfect solution for server owners who want to turn raw player data into meaningful insights and take their server to the next level—completely free.
